name: layers-e2e-roundtrip-private-helper
body: The applies-to round trip reads its assertions through the file's shared `query_cells` reader over an `artifacts::ArtifactDb` handle, so the `AppliesTo` pair (`Constraint → Language`, properties intact) and the materialised `Language` row are checked in `db.lbug`; the export serialisation the round trip used to reproduce locally is gone. Limit: `query_cells` is private to `tests/layers_e2e.rs`, so a sibling integration crate cannot reuse it. Upgrade by promoting it into `apg::testutil` when a second e2e crate needs the same cell reader.
